obj.sajikan: Siapkan makan malam. Abang pulang malam ini.

piring.1: Aku keluarkan dua piring dari lemari. Yang bawah sedikit retak, seperti biasa.
piring.2: Abang belum pulang, tapi piringnya sudah aku taruh.

air.1: Aku isi dua gelas di wastafel. Airnya jernih, cuma dingin.
air.2: Satu buat Abang, satu buat aku.

kulkas.1: Isi kulkas cuma telur dua butir dan sambal kemarin.
kulkas.2: Abang bilang nanti dia beli beras. Sudah dua minggu aku dengar kalimat itu.

foto.1: Foto orang tua di dinding ruang makan. Mereka berdua tersenyum di halaman yang kini penuh rumput.

makan.1: Aku pulang. Maaf, telat. Tadi aku muter-muter cari kerja.
makan.2: Piringnya sudah aku siapkan, Abang. Duduklah.
makan.4: Nasi goreng dari nasi kemarin. Bumbunya cuma kecap sama bawang.
makan.5: Kita makan pelan-pelan. Ada yang sudah lama ingin aku tanyakan.
makan.c2: Di laci ada kwitansi pinjol. Itu apa, Bang?

kerja.1: Kerjaan? Belum pasti. Rudi masih mau ngomong malam ini.
kerja.2: Abang capek. Makan dulu, nanti urusannya dipikir besok.
kerja.3: Iya. Nanti aku kabari kalau sudah jelas.

kwitansi.2: Kebuka sendiri waktu aku cari baterai. Aku cuma baca sebentar.
kwitansi.3: Itu urusan aku. Kau tidak usah pikirkan, ya.

kuliah.1: Kuliahku mulai minggu depan. Aku mau minta tolong soal biaya semester.
kuliah.2: Nanti Abang urus. Pelan-pelan, tapi pasti.
kuliah.3: Dia bilang begitu sambil memutar nasi di piringnya. Aku percaya, setengah.

ponsel.1: Ponsel Abang bergetar di meja. Dia mematikannya tanpa melihat layar.

tidur.1: Aku masuk kamar. Di ruang makan, Abang masih duduk memandang ponselnya yang gelap.
tidur.2: Malam ini tidak ada yang dijelaskan. Tapi setidaknya kita makan bersama.

obj.sajikan: Prepare dinner. Abang comes home tonight.
obj.tidur: Go to your room and rest.

piring.1: I take two plates out of the cupboard. The bottom one is a little cracked, as usual.
piring.2: Abang isn't home yet, but I've already set his plate.

air.1: I fill two glasses at the sink. The water is clear, just cold.
air.2: One for Abang, one for me.

kulkas.1: The fridge only has two eggs and yesterday's chili paste.
kulkas.2: Abang said he would buy rice later. I've been hearing that sentence for two weeks.

foto.1: Our parents' photo on the dining room wall. Both of them smiling in the yard that is now full of grass.

makan.1: I'm home. Sorry, it's late. I've been driving around looking for work.
makan.2: I already set your plate, Abang. Sit down.
makan.3: Smells good. What did you cook?
makan.4: Fried rice from yesterday's rice. Only soy sauce and onion.
makan.5: Let's eat slowly. There's something I've wanted to ask for a long time.
makan.c1: You got a new job, didn't you?
makan.c2: There's a loan receipt in the drawer. What is it, Bang?

kerja.1: A job? Not sure yet. Rudi still wants to talk tonight.
kerja.2: You're tired, Abang. Eat first, we'll think about it tomorrow.
kerja.3: Okay. I'll let you know when it's clear.

kwitansi.2: It opened by itself while I looked for a battery. I only read a little.
kwitansi.3: That's my business. Don't worry about it.

kuliah.1: My college starts next week. I want to ask for help with the semester fee.
kuliah.2: I'll handle it. Slowly, but surely.
kuliah.3: He said that while pushing rice around his plate. I believe him, halfway.

ponsel.1: Abang's phone buzzes on the table. He silences it without looking at the screen.
ponsel.2: It's nothing. The rice is good, Raka.

tidur.1: I go to my room. In the dining room, Abang still sits staring at his dark phone.
tidur.2: Nothing was explained tonight. But at least we ate together.
